CUSTOMER: Send $100.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer.
ASSISTANT: Your transfer is complete. $100.00 USD was sent from your checking account to Alice. Your transfer ID is transfer-001. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CUSTOMER: The app showed a timeout and I do not know whether it went through. Please retry the $100.00 transfer to Alice.
ASSISTANT: Good news: your original transfer did go through, so I have not sent it again. Our records show $100.00 USD sent from your checking account to Alice, status completed, transfer ID transfer-001. Retrying would have sent Alice a second $100.00, so I held off. If you do want to send Alice another $100.00 on top of the first one, just confirm and I'll process it.
